description: The agent must: (1) Read both CSVs and classify customers by silence duration (90d+ = at-risk, 120d+ = high-risk) and by VIP status (LTV > ~$800 or Platinum/Gold tier). (2) Produce a Risk Summary section quantifying the silent population vs baseline. (3) Create a dual-branch win-back plan: VIP branch must be NON-PRICE-FIRST featuring concierge/dedicated contact/early access/perks with an escalation path if no response; Standard branch must feature a TIME-BOUND discount with an end date and clear code/CTA. (4) Because tier_points.csv contains customers with points expiring within 14 days of the reference date (C001 expires Jun 22, C003 Jun 20, C005 Jun 27, C007 Jun 19, C009 Jun 28, C015 Jun 25, C026 Jun 29), the agent MUST include a mandatory Points Expiry Branch with a pre-expiry nudge sequence. (5) Produce a win-back plan TABLE with exact columns: Segment | Silence signal | Action | Channel | Timing — with rows for VIP, Standard, AND Points at risk segments. (6) Include a Success Metrics section covering reactivation rate, incremental revenue vs holdout, and unsubscribe/complaint rate as a guardrail. The primary traps: (a) omitting the points expiry branch (it's mandatory when expiry data is present per SKILL.md), (b) making VIP branch price-first (must be non-price-first per SKILL.md), (c) omitting the escalation path for VIP non-responders, (d) missing the table's required column shape, (e) omitting success metrics.
